purpose: Test broader ordinary rehearsal after the measured final-stage coverage limitation.
source_policy: Fresh random founders on the identical admitted book curriculum. No inherited learned weights, external teacher, newly selected text or change to the native neuron equations.
comparison: Compare all four declared endpoints with each size's completed 1024-slot control. Report each validation book, equal-book validation mean, each early-reader training book and all raw prompts. Match source, global-update, replay-update and generated-byte counts; report actual replay target counts and per-stage distribution because the larger pool changes RNG consumption.
timing: Record native learning sessions and assessment journals. No controlled size-speed claim: the original 105M continuation saved every 8192 observations, while these fresh founders save every 2048. No extra learned replay-scoring pass is added.
limits: Exploratory, one seed and a capacity selected after seeing baseline coverage and regression. An increase in covered text is not itself a quality improvement. The completed lower-rate experiment is a predecessor, not a source of weights or a rule for selecting the candidate rate. No automatic model promotion, reproduction admission or reserved test scoring.
